jump 365 140 90 intended: the round head runs into the straight right edge of the stem at its rightmost point without a corner, where the curvature of the ellipse ends; every reference joins the head and the stem so, and a head whose curvature fell to nothing there would be flat on its right (The Arrows, the Ties and the Pictorial Signs)
